description: Mostly fires at exactly 6 stones (move 7): strongest when the first player's stones are in columns 0/2/4 (not 3/5), the opponent's in 2/5, and the opponent's last move was in 4 or 6. A weaker second case is the late middlegame (28-32 stones) right after the opponent plays column 0, with columns 1, 3 and 6 tall and 2 and 4 short. Threats are irrelevant.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes the move probabilities by less than 0.01 on the 3 positions tested.
notes: Layer 0 unit driven by token position: band 9 is all ply 6. Within ply 6 the per-move column contributions are roughly additive (from act substitutions). The late component is diffuse (many small per-token effects) and only partly captured. Dev F1: p1 0.471, p2 0.484, p5 0.592 (best; P .605, R .580, AUROC .784), widening the late plies hurt (0.528). Simulation is nan on every call. Synthesis 4,2,0,5,4,4 = 0.040 > dev max 0.038.
